plugins.name: espos-firmware
plugins.description: ESP32 firmware knowledge distilled from building espOS: diagnosing memory budgets (PSRAM that appears to do nothing, IRAM a classic ESP32 counts as internal RAM, which pool TLS really uses, keeping an image inside its app slot), component checks that survive an ESP Component Registry install, and publishing firmware a browser-based flasher can fetch without GitHub Actions dropping a release.

plugins.name: espos-dev
plugins.description: Working on espOS and its child repos, or building your own firmware on it: which repo owns what and the contracts between them, building, releasing and keeping a firmware current with espOS on several chips, boards and flash sizes, listing it in the registry, and signing keys, OTA, the P4 radio co-processor update and fleet-key management through signalk-espos-manager.
